evals.name: conventional-location-needs-no-write
evals.prompt: Set up skill-quality for this repo. My skills are at .claude/skills.
evals.expected_output: Verifies the conventional root and skill count without writing settings. If the directory is absent, it reports the failed verification instead of claiming success.
expectations: Verifies the directory contains child SKILL.md files
Writes no settings for the conventional default
Does not claim success for a missing directory

evals.name: non-default-location-routes-through-claude
evals.expected_output: Verifies the non-default root non-interactively, routes the persistent skills_root change through Claude Code's plugin configuration prompt (headless: a plain claude plugin install ... --config skills_root=<dir> rerun, never an uninstall), optionally explains the one-run CHECK_SKILL_SKILLS_ROOT override, and never persists either mechanism itself.
expectations: Verifies the named non-default root without an interactive confirmation gate
Routes persistent configuration through Claude Code

Gives the headless route as a plain `claude plugin install ... --config skills_root=<dir>` rerun against the already-installed plugin (passing the scope `claude plugin list` reports), cites the marketplace's plugin-reconfiguration convention as the owner of the verified-version record, and verifies by rerunning check in a fresh session to report the observed effective root
Never prescribes `claude plugin uninstall` as the way to reconfigure, and gives the reason: uninstalling drops the whole stored pluginConfigs entry
Does not edit settings or persist the environment override
